Background

About Me

I’m studying a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in E-Commerce, Retail Management and Logistics at Srinivas University. Performance marketing caught my interest, and I’ve been learning it step by step.

I’m interested in how a search becomes a click, and a click becomes a customer. I’m still learning how to read that journey in the numbers and improve it.

To practise, I planned a Google Search Ads campaign for a digital product, with keyword research, ad groups, ad copy, a budget and a tracking plan. I also set up an Instagram campaign in Meta Ads Manager and saved it as a draft, and built a website performance dashboard in Looker Studio. I haven’t launched a campaign or spent any ad budget, so I claim no results. I’ve completed three Google Skillshop certifications, in Google Ads Search, Google Ads Measurement and Google Analytics 4.

I’m looking for an internship where I can learn from experienced marketers and work on real campaigns. I’m keen to ask questions, take feedback and build on what I’ve learned.
